panel.title: OpenBot Dock
panel.subtitle: OpenBot Agent Dock %1
panel.aboveApps.title: Dock above other windows
panel.aboveApps.description: Restarts OpenBot on XWayland so the dock floats at the screen edge.
panel.aboveApps.hintOn: Dock on the right edge. To make it hide and slide out as the pointer reaches the edge, turn on “Hide automatically” in OpenBot → Settings → Agent Dock. Drag the dock to move it up or down the edge.
panel.aboveApps.hintOff: The dock lives inside the OpenBot window. Turning this on lifts it to the screen edge, like the macOS dock.
